lines.beaver_en: Wow, the final was amazing! How was it for you?
lines.en: Maybe because it was the final, the competition was really fierce.

lines.beaver_en: The other side was strong, right?
lines.learner: 응, 상대편 공격이 워낙 빨라서 걱정했어.
lines.en: Yeah, their attack was so fast that I was worried.
lines.roman: Eung, sangdaepyeon gonggyeogi wonak ppallaseo geokjeonghaesseo.

lines.beaver: 맞아, 전반에 골 먹었을 때 다들 놀랐잖아.
lines.beaver_en: Right, everyone was shocked when we gave up a goal early.
lines.beaver_roman: Maja, jeonbane gol meogeosseul ttae dadeul nollatjana.
lines.learner: 그때 우리 팀이 좀 흔들렸지. 그래도 잘 버텼어.
lines.en: Our team was a bit shaken then. But they held on well.
lines.roman: Geuttae uri timi jom heundeullyeotji. Geuraedo jal beotyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: What did you think of the last goal?
lines.learner: 쭉 뻗어서 들어간 골이라 정말 멋있었어!
lines.en: The ball shot straight in, so it was really cool!
lines.roman: Jjuk ppeodeoseo deureogan gorira jeongmal meosisseosseo!

lines.beaver_en: We won in the end! Feels great, right?
lines.learner: 응, 우승하는 걸 직접 보니까 눈물이 났어.
lines.en: Yeah, seeing the win in person made me cry.
lines.roman: Eung, useunghaneun geol jikjeop bonikka nunmuri nasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Since they won, the prize money must be big.
lines.learner: 상금이 꽤 많대. 선수들이 받을 만해.
lines.en: I heard it's a lot. The players deserve it.
lines.roman: Sanggeumi kkwae mandae. Seonsudeuri badeul manhae.

lines.beaver: 넌 오늘 시합에서 뭐가 제일 좋았어?
lines.beaver_en: What did you like most about today's match?
lines.beaver_roman: Neon oneul sihabeseo mwoga jeil joasseo?
lines.en: I liked how they kept attacking until the end.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 넌 축구 말고 다른 경기도 봐?
lines.beaver_en: Right. Do you watch other sports besides soccer?
lines.beaver_roman: Maja. Neon chukgu malgo dareun gyeonggido bwa?
lines.learner: 응. 나는 씨름에 대해서도 관심이 많아.
lines.en: Yeah. I'm really interested in ssireum, too.
lines.roman: Eung. Naneun ssireume daehaeseodo gwansimi mana.

lines.learner: 응, 씨름도 힘 싸움이 정말 대단해.
lines.en: Yeah, the battle of strength in ssireum is really amazing.
lines.roman: Eung, ssireumdo him ssaumi jeongmal daedanhae.

lines.beaver_en: Let's watch a ssireum match together next time!
lines.learner: 좋아! 다음 시합도 같이 보러 가자.
lines.en: Sounds good! Let's go watch the next match together.
lines.roman: Joa! Daeum sihapdo gachi boreo gaja.
